Wells Fargo & Company (WFC) Holder Solaris Asset Management Has Boosted Stake; Selkirk Management Trimmed Grubhub (GRUB) Stake by $1.85 Million; Stock Price Rose 
April 22, 2018 - By Maria Brooks 
Solaris Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Wells Fargo & Company (WFC) by 8.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Solaris Asset Management Llc bought 5,615 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 70,227 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.26 million, up from 64,612 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Solaris Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Company for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $256.17 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.98% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $52.56. About 31.15 million shares traded or 28.97% up from the average. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since April 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500. 
Selkirk Management Llc decreased its stake in Grubhub Inc. (GRUB) by 16.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selkirk Management Llc sold 26,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 44.05% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 131,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.41 million, down from 157,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selkirk Management Llc who had been investing in Grubhub Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $8.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $101.67. About 816,582 shares traded. GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has risen 206.92% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.37% the S&P500.
